testimony.subject: Circumstances of fee patent issuance and subsequent land loss
testimony.key_claims: She is age 38, is a Rosebud Sioux allottee who received a fee patent through the mail without having applied for it. She signed a receipt and accepted it without protest. She no longer owns the land; it was mortgaged once for $75.00 to H. D. Haskell of Wakefield, Nebraska (not foreclosed), then sold for $1100.00, not paid in cash. $275.00 was due for taxes; she received an automobile; mortgage of $75.00 and $25.00 for interest and expenses were settled. She states that if she had not had a patent she would not have lost the land. She lost it because she could not meet the taxes and had too many other more important expenses concerning one of her children's health. She is in good health, supports her children by farming.
